extracted.intended_audience: CIA office directors/staffs and agency personnel asked to comment (Office of Logistics recipients)
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and submit agency comments and implementation suggestions in response to a draft OMB circular about eliminating free parking for federal employees; submissions are routed through the Office of Logistics for collation into an Agency response to OMB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit comments to Logistics by deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send your comments direct to Logistics by 18 April.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Office of Logistics requested forwarding of any comments and suggestions for implementing the program; submissions should be sent directly to Logistics by the stated date so they may be included in the Agency response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide suggestions for implementing the program
rubrics_metrics.description: We have been asked by the Office of Logistics to forward any comments we might have as well as any suggestions for implementing the program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When responding, include concrete suggestions for implementing the elimination of free parking (practical measures, operational issues, impacts on personnel/operations). Logistics will collate any comments into an overall Agency response to OMB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Route comments through specified distribution channels
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the designated distribution/chain-of-command for internal routing of comments (i.e., send one copy each to Office Directors/Staffs and DDA chrono as indicated) so that Logistics can assemble a complete agency submission.
